_HOW_TO_EDIT: This file controls the 'Current Calendar' box on the Course Calendar page.
TO SHOW YOUR GOOGLE DOC: paste its link between the quotes of "embedUrl". The ordinary link from Google Docs is fine - the page converts it for embedding by itself.
IMPORTANT - SHARING: the doc must be viewable without signing in, or visitors get an empty grey box. In Google Docs: Share -> General access -> 'Anyone with the link' -> Viewer.
ALTERNATIVE: File -> Share -> Publish to the web, then paste the address it gives you (it ends in /pub). That also works and does not expose the editing link.
LEAVE IT EMPTY ("") and the page shows the fallbackText message instead - no broken box.
heading is the title shown above the doc. height is how tall the embedded doc is, in pixels.
heading: Current Calendar
fallbackText: The live course calendar, deadlines, and schedule updates are posted in Canvas for the active quarter.
